report: The three sisters have agreed on a first phase of work. C will arrange an independent appraisal of the house (explicitly a neutral valuation, not an agreement to any sale price). B will contact the executor or lawyer to review the will, and is working out a realistic budget for her dance studio so she can state what she needs. A accepted the appraisal as a fair baseline while reserving her position on final purchase terms. A shared concerns list is in place: C wants a fair financial share and has not agreed to subsidize A's purchase; A wants to buy the house and build financial independence at a fair price; B wants a realistic chance to fund her dance studio. Next step: once the will review and appraisal results come back, the sisters should discuss purchase terms together against the appraised value as the neutral baseline. I made no legal decisions and moved no money.
